name: milestones
description: GitHub milestone setup, audit, idea exploration, issue planning, issue-file implementation planning, and GoalBuddy issue-resolution workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Route, set up, audit, plan, and resolve milestone-backed GitHub issues.
interface.longDescription: Milestones groups the local project-management workflow skills for routing milestone work, strict milestone setup, milestone audits and repairs, exploratory idea audits, GitHub issue creation, milestone-local issue-file implementation plans, and GoalBuddy-backed issue execution. It composes with Superpowers for brainstorming, TDD, debugging, subagents, review, and verification.
